Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Kon Knueppel - Out: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.
Grant Williams - Out: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

Santi Aldama - Out: Aldama (knee) is probable to suit up for Friday's game against the Jazz.
Max Christie - Day-To-Day: Christie (hip) is probable for Friday's game against the Jazz.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
Sandro Mamukelashvili - Day-To-Day: Mamukelashvili (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Portland.
Isaiah Stewart - Out: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Scotty Pippen Jr. - Out: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.
Kam Jones - Out: Jones (ankle/two-way player) is out for Friday's game against Toronto.
Terrence Shannon Jr. - Day-To-Day: Shannon (hip) is questionable for Friday's game against New Orleans.
Anthony Edwards - Out: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Yves Missi - Out: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
Trey Murphy III - Day-To-Day: Murphy (knee) is probable for Friday's game against Minnesota.
Jaylin Williams - Out: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Nikola Topic - Out: Topic (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
Thomas Sorber - Out: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

Cason Wallace - Out: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Chet Holmgren - Out: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Jalen Williams - Out: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Adem Bona - Day-To-Day: Bona (back) is doubtful to play in Friday's game against the Cavaliers, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Vit Krejci - Out: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Ja Morant - Out: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.
Shaedon Sharpe - Out: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Maxime Raynaud - Out: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
Keegan Murray - Out: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
Ben Simmons - Out: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Tobias Harris - Out: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.
Jayden Quaintance - Out: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
Scottie Barnes - Day-To-Day: Barnes (groin) is questionable to play Friday's game against the Bucks.
Kawhi Leonard - Out: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Nate Bittle - Out: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.
Jusuf Nurkic - Out: Nurkic (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.
Jaren Jackson Jr. - Out: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Trey Alexander - Out: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

Reece Beekman - Out: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Tristan Vukcevic - Out: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.
Justin Champagnie - Out: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Ryan Poehling - Injured Reserve: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.
